Stop the cycle of revenge. Track down [[Kisai]]'s sister [[Natsumi]] before she does something rash.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find [[Imperial Guard]] [[Miyuki]] in [[Wajjun Bazaar]].
* Ask around to find out where Imperial Guard Natsumi has been.
* Head to the location Miyuki has suggested.
* Defeat [[Meijun, Vengeful Eye]] and his allies.
* See [[Lei Jeng]] For your reward.

===Reward===
*2,500 [[Experience]]
*1,500 [[Gold]]
*[[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==

Miyuki is just south of [[The Marketplace]], battling a single Jade Brotherhood member. Help her defeat and interrogate him. Search for more [[Jade Brotherhood Member]]s and [[Peasant]]s in Wajjun Bazaar. Depending on the NPC you speak to, some of the options will increase the progress bar more than the other options, while other options won't increase the progress bar at all. Jade Brotherhood Members have a higher effect on the bar than the peasants with one exception. If you ask Peasant 1, "Who's your daddy?" he tells you his father is Yon Ruino. Speaking to Yon Ruino will greatly increase the bar's progress. After you have found enough evidence, head towards the Jade Brotherhood headquarters on the dock north of Wajjun Bazaar. Defeat Meijun's party to finish the quest. Make sure that Miyuki follows you while you gather information, or you will not be able to finish the quest, as Miyuki tends to get stuck between the NPCs and gets left behind.

The most efficient way of gathering evidence:
*Head to Miyuki at the start
*Continue past her to defeat and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 1, picking the first option. 
*Head directly west to speak to Peasant 1, picking the third option. 
*Retrace your steps northeast until Yon Ruino is visible and speak to him. 
*Head west along the waterfront and speak to Peasant 5, picking the first option. This will be enough to fill the bar in Normal Mode.
*For Hard Mode, continue west along the dock and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 5, choosing option two, which will be enough to fill the bar. 
*From here, continue on as normal to defeat Meijun and his group.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lei Jeng
:''"I heard about what happened on Mount Qinkai... It's despicable that the Jade Brotherhood would use your friends to get at you like that, but it's not particularly unusual for them. Unfortunately for me, not everyone is as levelheaded as you are. One of my subordinates, Imperial Guard Natsumi, is a relative of one of the students you rescued and has decided to take it upon herself to go and seek revenge on the ones responsible. She doesn't seem to understand attacking the Brotherhood again like this will just cause more acts of retaliation.''
:''"Natsumi's partner has volunteered to track her down. If you're up to it, I'd like to ask you to head to '''Wajjun Bazaar''', and check on '''Miyuki's''' investigation."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = We've got to stop this before it spirals out of control.
| decline = But I love revenge!
| ask = Miyuki is in '''Wajjun Bazaar''' looking for her partner, Natsumi. If you want to help, you should head over there.
}}

:'''Jade Brotherhood Member:''' ''"Ha! Like anyone would listen to someone like you!"''
:'''Jade Brotherhood Member:''' ''"Uh-oh! Reinforcements? I'm outta here!"''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Wait! Get back here!"''

;Miyuki
:''"Argh! Another one that ran off before I could get any useful information out of him. If only Natsumi were here, she's much more intimidating."''
:'''⇒ "Lei Jeng sent me to help."'''

:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Captain Lei sent you to help? I appreciate it. I can't say I've made much progress so far."''

He got that name due to his penchant for revenge attacks whenever the Am Fah attacked him or one of his friends. And, as you already know, he is not afraid to apply his techniques to others outside the Am Fah."''

The folks around here are usually pretty cooperative, but we may have to rough up some Jade Brotherhood if we want to get answers from them."''

Dialogue 1:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"Can you tell me anything else about Meijun? I've only met him once before."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Then you probably know enough. He has an unhealthy obsession with the idea of revenge. To him, there's no slight small enough to avoid his wrath."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Since the Ministry assault against their leaders, his acts of revenge have gotten even more violent. I shouldn't have to say this, but not everyone has been as lucky as Kisai and her friends."''
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"In that case, I'll make sure this is the last time."''

Dialogue 2:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"How did you end up being partnered with someone like Natsumi?"''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"That was Captain Lei's decision actually; I'm not sure what he was thinking when he assigned us. Perhaps he wanted me to look after Natsumi's short temper, or perhaps he wanted me to learn from her exemplary fighting skills."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"It's funny actually. I actually almost arrested Natsumi on her first day of work. She had knocked over a fruit stand in her rush to pick up her armor from the smith, and I was on duty nearby. I made her help clean it up before I let her go, and she was late to report in as a result."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Captain Lei was pretty angry. But Natsumi and I have become good friends and partners since then."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"It's not that things have gotten better. It's that things are getting worse somewhere else. Somewhere we can't protect as easily."''

Dialogue 3:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"It feels like the streets are calmer than usual."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Well we have the Ministry of Purity to thank for that I suppose. The Imperial Guard has never had the manpower to stop all the gangs that roam around in a city this big, so having the extra support certainly helps."''
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"You don't sound very convinced of that."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"I... I guess I'm not. It looks better on the outside, and we've had to deal with less outright incidences of violence lately, but that's not the whole story."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Something is brewing behind the scenes here. The citizens I've seen lately all seem apprehensive of something but won't talk to us about it. Besides that I've noticed increased reports of robbery and kidnappings lately."''

Dialogue 4:
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Natsumi can be a handful at times, but this is the first time that she's directly gone against the captain like this. She's always been very protective of Kisai and Jun, though."''
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"I can understand her anger; after all, it seems like this is partly my fault. But Lei is right that we need to stop her before this gets worse."''
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"I agree, let's find her as quickly as possible."''

After completing the investigation:
:'''Miyuki:''' ''"Alright, I think we've got enough information. Let me see your map. Based on their testimony, I think we should head here next."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Lei Jeng
:''"Thank you for your help. Natsumi has a tendency to overreact to things, but in this case I can't really blame her. To have her sister attacked and left for dead as a means of example to another... Well, I'm just glad we were able to stop her in time. Having Meijun off the streets should hopefully slow down the Brotherhood as well. Now let's see this document she managed to recover.''
:''"Hmm, this is disturbing. It seems to be some kind of draft of a treaty agreement. The other party is blank, however, so I'm not sure who it is. It seems the actions of the Ministry of Purity have driven even the Brotherhood to seek allies elsewhere. I'll start an investigation into this, so don't worry. In the meantime, please take this as compensation for your assistance."''

==Notes==
* Peasants don't have much information to share. You gain the most progress by speaking to the Jade Brotherhood Members.
* Make sure Miyuki is following you to "the location Miyuki has suggested", as she can get stuck on the way there, and the quest won't update without her presence.
{{Bug|Miyuki will become stuck on NPCs along the way, a simple fix is get her unstuck on any she does so that the quest will update when you head to the location of Natsumi.}}

==Trivia==
* The third dialogue options for Jade Brotherhood Member 2 (''"airspeed velocity of an unladen moa bird"'') and its answer (''"Ascalonian or Krytan"'') is a reference to the "African or European" "unladen swallow" from [[w:Monty Python and the Holy Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]].
** Likewise, Jade Brotherhood Member 5 (''"fresh fruit"'') may reference the play [[w:Self Defence Against Fresh Fruit|Self Defence Against Fresh Fruit]] by the same comedy group.
* The third dialogue option for Jade Brotherhood Member 4, ''"Do you know where I can find some sailors?"'' is a reference to the video game [[w:Shenmue|Shenmue]].
* The third dialogue option for Peasant 3, ''"Do you know what they call a moa burger with cheese in Elona?"''' is a reference to [[w:Pulp Fiction|Pulp Fiction]].
* The third dialogue option for Peasant 5, ''"Do you feel lucky, punk?"'' is a reference to [[w:Dirty Harry|Dirty Harry]].
* The third dialogue option for Jade Brotherhood Member 1, ''"Have you ever danced with Dhuum in the pale moonlight?"'' is a variation of one of The Joker's lines from [[W:Batman_(1989_film)|Batman]].
* The names of the two imperial guards, Miyuki and Natsumi, are a reference to the lead characters from the manga and anime [[w:You're Under Arrest (manga)|You're Under Arrest]].
